Autocomplete ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

When to use it ​

Suggest completions for free-text fields such as addresses and names. ASAM's options mode filters by label, skips disabled options, and returns the original option object on selection. The model stores display text. For a fixed option-value model, use Select.

ASAM static options ​

maxSuggestions defaults to 100 and accepts positive integers. It limits only suggestions from ASAM options or the data bridge. On a match, select preserves object identity, including the original value, label, raw, and custom fields. Suggestion arrays, the default slot, and handleSelect use complete suggestion objects.

Suggestion functions and multifile data ​

fetchSuggestions takes precedence over options. Provide an array or a function that supplies results by callback, returns an array, or returns a Promise that resolves to an array. valueKey sets the display field. maxSuggestions leaves native results intact.

ts
export interface ServiceSuggestion {
	label: string;
	code: string;
}
const services: ServiceSuggestion[] = [
	{ label: '设计服务', code: 'DES' },
	{ label: '开发服务', code: 'DEV' }
];
export async function suggest(query: string): Promise<ServiceSuggestion[]> {
	return services.filter((item) => item.label.includes(query));
}

Input decorations and the suggestion instance ​

The instance exposes activated, loading, suggestions, and highlightedIndex. Its getData, handleSelect, and handleKeyEnter methods are asynchronous.

The example buttons first focus the input and wait for suggestions to render. The first-item action queries the prefix for Shanghai and highlights Shanghai. Press Enter to select it. Closing the suggestions preserves the typed value. The example combines prefix, suffix, prepend, and append, plus a Close icon that clears the model. You can fetch and select suggestions again after clearing.

Example: instance

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<div class="row">
			<AsamButton type="primary" @click="focusInput">聚焦补全</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" @click="getCitySuggestions">获取建议</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="highlightFirst">高亮首项</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="input?.close()">关闭建议</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<AsamAutocomplete
			ref="input"
			v-model="value"
			v-bind="{ class: 'field', 'aria-label': '实例补全' }"
			:options="options"
			:debounce="0"
			clearable
			:clear-icon="Close"
		>
			<template #prefix>
				<Search style="width: 16px" />
			</template>
			<template #suffix>补全</template>
			<template #prepend>城市搜索</template>
			<template #append>城市</template>
		</AsamAutocomplete>
		<output>{{ JSON.stringify({ value }) }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteInstanceExample' });
import { nextTick, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamAutocomplete, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAutocompleteExpose, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { Search, Close } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
const input = ref<AsamAutocompleteExpose>();
const value = ref('');
const options: AsamOption<string>[] = [
	{ value: 'shanghai', label: '上海', raw: { code: 'SH' } },
	{ value: 'beijing', label: '北京', raw: { code: 'BJ' } }
];
async function prepareSuggestions(query: string) {
	// The button takes focus first. Let the previous native blur close finish
	// before establishing a new focused, rendered suggestions panel.
	await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
	const control = input.value;
	if (!control) return;
	control.focus();
	await nextTick();
	await control.getData(query);
	await nextTick();
}
async function focusInput() {
	await prepareSuggestions(value.value);
}
async function getCitySuggestions() {
	await prepareSuggestions('上');
}
async function highlightFirst() {
	await prepareSuggestions('上');
	input.value?.highlight(0);
}
</script>

Sizes and inheritance ​

ASAM offers large, big, default, and small. An explicit size overrides inheritance. If omitted, the nearest component, group, form, or ConfigProvider setting applies, with default as the fallback. Change the provider size to see inherited values update.

Example: sizes

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<div class="row density-row">
			<div v-for="size in sizes" :key="size" class="field density-field">
				<strong>{{ size }}</strong>
				<AsamAutocomplete
					:size="size"
					v-bind="{ class: 'field', 'aria-label': size + '尺寸' }"
					model-value="ASAM"
					:fetch-suggestions="[]"
				/>
			</div>
		</div>
		<AsamConfigProvider :size="density">
			<div class="example">
				<AsamAutocomplete
					v-bind="{ class: 'field', 'aria-label': '继承尺寸' }"
					model-value="ASAM"
					:fetch-suggestions="[]"
				/>
				<div class="row" role="group" aria-label="继承尺寸">
					<span>继承尺寸</span>
					<AsamButton type="default" @click="density = 'small'">small</AsamButton>
					<AsamButton type="default" @click="density = 'big'">big</AsamButton>
				</div>
			</div>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
		<output>配置提供器：{{ density }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const sizes = ['large', 'big', 'default', 'small'] as const;
const density = ref<AsamControlSize>('big');
</script>

ASAM extensions and migration ​

ASAM adds options, maxSuggestions, and original-object selection. See the full notes.

Popper configuration ​

showArrow and popperOptions apply to the suggestion popper. Use teleported and appendTo to control where it mounts, and fitInputWidth to match the input width. Style it with popperClass and popperStyle. A popper teleported to body may need its own theme variables.

			v-model="query"
			:options="options"

Asynchronous suggestions and keyboard submission ​

fetchSuggestions accepts an array or a function that supplies results by callback, returns an array, or returns a Promise. It takes precedence over ASAM options and remoteSuggestions, and maxSuggestions leaves its results intact. See the full notes.

Use debounce to delay queries, triggerOnFocus to query on focus, highlightFirstItem to highlight the initial row, and loopNavigation to wrap arrow-key navigation. See the full notes.

The select payload is T | AsamOption<V, I> | { value: string | number }. See the full notes.

Example: async

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamAutocomplete
			v-model="query"
			:fetch-suggestions="fetchSuggestions"
			:debounce="100"
			:trigger-on-focus="false"
			select-when-unmatched
			highlight-first-item
			:loop-navigation="false"
			aria-label="异步建议"
			@select="handleSelect"
		>
			<template #default="{ item }">
				{{ item.value }} · {{ 'id' in item ? item.id : '' }}
			</template>
			<template #loading>查询中，请稍候</template>
		</AsamAutocomplete>
		<output>选择：{{ selected }}</output>
		<p class="example-paragraph">

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteAsyncExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamAutocomplete } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAutocompleteEmits, AsamValue, AsamRecord } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Suggestion {
	value: string;
	id: number;
}
const query = ref('');
const selected = ref('');
async function fetchSuggestions(query: string): Promise<Suggestion[]> {
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 400));
	return query === '自由输入' ? [] : [{ value: query + ' suggestion', id: 42 }];
}
function handleSelect(item: AsamAutocompleteEmits<AsamValue, AsamRecord, Suggestion>['select'][0]) {
	if ('id' in item) selected.value = `匹配建议 #${item.id}：${JSON.stringify(item)}`;
	else if ('label' in item) selected.value = `匹配选项 ${item.label}：${JSON.stringify(item)}`;
	else selected.value = `未匹配：${JSON.stringify(item)}`;
}
</script>

			v-model="callbackValue"

			select-when-unmatched
			aria-label="回调建议"
			@select="selected = JSON.stringify($event)"
		/>
		<AsamAutocomplete
			v-model="promiseValue"

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteNativeProtocolsExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamAutocomplete } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const arrayValue = ref('');
const callbackValue = ref('');
const promiseValue = ref('');
const selected = ref('');
const items = [
	{ value: 'Alpha', code: 'a' },
	{ value: 'Beta', code: 'b' }
];
const filter = (query: string) =>
	items.filter((item) => item.value.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()));
function callback(query: string, done: (items: { value: string; code: string }[]) => void) {
	done(filter(query));
}
async function promise(query: string) {
	return filter(query);
}
</script>

Reading the API ​

The API below reflects the current public types and runtime defaults. “Unknown / Not declared” means no default is documented by the runtime. Omit size to inherit the ancestor setting and disabled to inherit the form state. Use validateEvent to control validation events.

The native default for showArrow is true. Set it to false to hide the arrow.

Inherited input options ​

The underlying input receives min, max, step, formatter, parser, modelModifiers, and textarea props unchanged. See the full notes.

With ASAM options or remoteSuggestions, filtering uses the label, skips disabled entries, preserves original option objects, and applies the maxSuggestions limit. See the full notes.

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamAutocomplete } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAutocompleteEmits } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteNativeInputExample' });
const options = [{ value: 'Alice', label: 'Alice' }];
const numeric = ref<string | number>('1');
const amount = ref<string | number>('1234');
const modified = ref<string | number>('');
const text = ref('👩‍👩‍👧‍👦');
const updates = ref<(string | number)[]>([]);
function record(...[value]: AsamAutocompleteEmits['update:modelValue']) {
	updates.value.push(value);
}
const formatter = (value: string) =>
	value === '' ? '' : '$' + value.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
const parser = (value: string) => value.replace(/[$,]/g, '');
const countGraphemes = (value: string) => Array.from(new Intl.Segmenter().segment(value)).length;
</script>

Form inheritance and validation across five inputs ​

This complete TS/JS example includes the single-line, password, multiline, autocomplete, and tag inputs. Each leaves disabled unset to inherit the form state. validateEvent controls automatic validation on change and blur per input. Toggling the disabled state preserves the model, and editing still works when automatic validation is off. Each of the five pages contains a self-contained copy of the example.

	<!-- prettier-ignore -->

				/>

				label="标签"
				prop="tags"

				/>
			</AsamFormItem>

		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="reset">重置模型和校验记录</AsamButton>

			提交编辑
		</AsamButton>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamBaseForm,
	AsamFormItem,
	AsamInput,
	AsamPassword,
	AsamTextarea,
	AsamAutocomplete,
	AsamInputTag
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamBaseFormExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamFiveInputsFormExample' });
const model = ref({
	input: '',
	password: '',
	textarea: '',
	autocomplete: '',
	tags: [] as string[]
});
const disabled = ref(false);
const validateEvent = ref(true);
const submission = ref('尚未提交');
const form = ref<AsamBaseFormExpose>();
const rules = Object.fromEntries(
	['input', 'password', 'textarea', 'autocomplete', 'tags'].map((key) => [
		key,
		[{ required: true, message: '请完善此项', trigger: ['change', 'blur'] }]
	])
);
const suggestions = [{ value: 'Alpha' }];
const validations = ref<{ prop: string; valid: boolean }[]>([]);
function record(prop: string | string[], valid: boolean) {
	validations.value.push({ prop: String(prop), valid });
}
async function submit() {
	if (disabled.value || !form.value) return;

	try {
		const valid = await form.value.validate();
		submission.value = valid ? '编辑已提交' : '请完善必填项后再提交';
	} catch {
		submission.value = '请完善必填项后再提交';
	}
}
function reset() {
	form.value?.resetFields();
	validations.value = [];
	submission.value = '尚未提交';
}
</script>
<style scoped>
.example {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

Asynchronous suggestions and dynamic input states ​

The native input handles readonly, disabled, and inherited form state. These settings control editability in the UI. The underlying 2.14.7 input determines how handleSelect, keyboard selection, and pending suggestions behave. ASAM forwards native model and select events as emitted, and the parent can still update the model.

Example: state

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<!-- prettier-ignore -->
	<div class="example">
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="readonly">只读</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled">禁用表单</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamBaseForm
			:model="{ value }"
			:disabled="disabled"
		>
			<AsamAutocomplete
				v-model="value"
				:readonly="readonly"
				:fetch-suggestions="suggestions"
				highlight-first-item
				aria-label="动态异步建议"
				@update:model-value="events.push('update')"
				@select="events.push('select')"
			/>
		</AsamBaseForm>
		<output>{{ JSON.stringify({ value, readonly, disabled, events }) }}</output>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamBaseForm, AsamAutocomplete } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteStateExample' });

compositionstart, compositionupdate, and compositionend carry the native CompositionEvent. See the full notes.

			v-model="value"
			:options="options"
			:debounce="0"
			clearable
			aria-label="补全继承输入事件"
			@keydown="keyed"
			@mouseenter="entered"
			@mouseleave="left"
			@compositionstart="started"
			@compositionupdate="updated"
			@compositionend="ended"
			@select="record('select', $event)"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button">移出输入焦点</AsamButton>
		<output>{{ JSON.stringify({ value, events }) }}</output>
	</div>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamAutocomplete } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAutocompleteEmits } from '@asam-ui/ui';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteEventsDemo' });
const value = ref('');
const options = [{ value: 'alpha', label: 'Alpha', raw: { id: 'alpha' } }];
const events = ref<{ name: string; value: unknown }[]>([]);
function record(name: string, value: unknown) {
	events.value.push({ name, value });
}
function keyed(...[event]: AsamAutocompleteEmits['keydown']) {
	record('keydown', event instanceof KeyboardEvent ? event.key : event.type);
}
function entered(...[event]: AsamAutocompleteEmits['mouseenter']) {
	record('mouseenter', event.type);
}
function left(...[event]: AsamAutocompleteEmits['mouseleave']) {
	record('mouseleave', event.type);
}
function started(...[event]: AsamAutocompleteEmits['compositionstart']) {
	record('compositionstart', event.data);
}
function updated(...[event]: AsamAutocompleteEmits['compositionupdate']) {
	record('compositionupdate', event.data);
}
function ended(...[event]: AsamAutocompleteEmits['compositionend']) {
	record('compositionend', event.data);
}
</script>

	gap: var(--asam-space-md);

Dynamic input type and state ​

Switch between text, password, and number in the same input and observe the parent model, focus, and prefix slot. The native input handles type switches, pending lazy values, and text-selection limitations in number mode. It retains browser cursor behavior and the native setSelectionRange method. Textarea mode renders a native textarea.

Native delegation and event logging ​

The complete TS/JS example logs model updates and event order. It also lets you toggle disabled, read-only, and automatic validation states. See the full notes.

vue
<template>
	<section class="native-comparison">
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled">禁用</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="readonly">只读</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="validateEvent">自动校验</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<p class="example-paragraph">ASAM</p>
		<AsamAutocomplete
			v-model="asam"
			:disabled="disabled"
			:readonly="readonly"
			:validate-event="validateEvent"
			:fetch-suggestions="suggestions"
			:debounce="0"
			aria-label="ASAM 原生委托"
			@update:model-value="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'update:modelValue', ...args)"
			@input="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'input', ...args)"
			@change="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'change', ...args)"
			@blur="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'blur', ...args)"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="events = []">
			清空事件记录
		</AsamButton>
		<pre>{{ JSON.stringify({ asam, events }, null, 2) }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamAutocomplete } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteNativeDelegationExample' });
const asam = ref<string | number>('');
const disabled = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const validateEvent = ref(true);
const suggestions = [{ value: 'Alpha', label: 'Alpha' }];
const events = ref<{ source: string; event: string; values: unknown[] }[]>([]);
function record(source: string, event: string, ...values: unknown[]) {
	events.value.push({
		source,
		event,
		values: values.map((value) => (value instanceof Event ? value.type : value))
	});
}
</script>

Additional usage notes ​

ASAM extensions and migration ​

ASAM adds options, maxSuggestions, and original-object selection. remoteSuggestions is the data bridge. For app-level remote or provider support, use RemoteAutocomplete. Use Password for passwords and Textarea for ordinary multiline text. Omit size to inherit it. Configure the suggestion panel with this page's API.

Asynchronous suggestions and keyboard submission ​

fetchSuggestions accepts arrays, callbacks, synchronous array returns, or Promises and takes precedence over options and remoteSuggestions. maxSuggestions leaves native results intact. Static ASAM options are filtered by label and disabled. Selection stores the label in the string model and emits the original option with its custom fields. See AsamRemoteAutocomplete for the remote data wrapper.

Asynchronous suggestions and keyboard submission ​

debounce delays queries, triggerOnFocus queries on focus, highlightFirstItem highlights the first result, and loopNavigation wraps arrow-key navigation. With selectWhenUnmatched set to true, Enter with no highlighted match emits { value: modelValue }. The value stays a string or number and the key stays value, even with a custom valueKey. This payload contains only that field. With false or an omitted setting, the unmatched Enter emits no select. Pressing Enter and calling handleKeyEnter follow the same protocol. Customize the loading indicator with the loading slot. header, footer, and default customize the list and complete suggestion rows.

Asynchronous suggestions and keyboard submission ​

The select type is T | AsamOption<V, I> | { value: string | number }. Narrow by field presence before accessing label, raw, or custom fields. The example checks 'label' in item for a complete ASAM option and 'id' in item for a complete native suggestion, then reads only value in the remaining branch. The full TS/JS example shows both the original matched object and the minimal unmatched payload. Enter free text, wait for an empty suggestion list, then press Enter.

Inherited input options ​

min, max, step, formatter, parser, modelModifiers, and textarea props pass through. The native branch applies when both options and remoteSuggestions are absent or when fetchSuggestions is supplied. It uses native defaults for placeholder, debounce, and valueKey. Native queries require a suggestion source, supplied as an array or function.

Inherited input options ​

ASAM's options and remoteSuggestions filter by label, skip disabled entries, preserve original options, and apply maxSuggestions. In both branches, the underlying input owns editing, lazy, password visibility, and change/blur validation. Drafts, commits, event timing, and the parent model retain native behavior.

Inherited input events ​

The composition events carry CompositionEvent. mouseenter and mouseleave carry MouseEvent, and keydown carries KeyboardEvent | Event. Each of these six events is forwarded once from the actual input. Keyboard listeners preserve arrow-key highlighting and Enter selection. focus and blur carry FocusEvent. input and change carry the model value, while select carries a complete match or the value-only unmatched payload.

Native delegation and event logging ​

The complete TS/JS example logs model updates and event order and lets you toggle disabled, read-only, and automatic validation states. Omitted base props use the native defaults. Explicit undefined, null, and false pass through when allowed by the API. ASAM supplies four visual sizes. Password fixes type to password and enables the visibility toggle when showPassword is omitted.

Props AsamAutocompleteProps

NameDescriptionTypeDefault

optionsASAM static options, filtered by label and disabled state.readonly AsamOption<V, I>[] | undefined—

maxSuggestionsMaximum ASAM static/remote option suggestions. Native suggestions are not truncated.number | undefined—
remoteSuggestionsInternal data-layer bridge preserving ASAM option objects.((query: string) => Promise<readonly AsamOption<V, I>[]>) | undefined—
idNative id capability.string | undefined—

ts
import type { Attrs } from 'vue';
import type { AsamAutocompleteProps, AsamValue, AsamRecord, AsamOption, AsamAutocompleteFetchSuggestions, AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamAutocompleteProps
type PublicContract<V extends AsamValue = AsamValue, I extends object = AsamRecord, T extends object = AsamOption<V, I>> = {
	readonly "modelValue"?: string | number | undefined;
	readonly "min"?: (string | number) | undefined;
	readonly "max"?: (string | number) | undefined;
	readonly "step"?: (string | number) | undefined;
	readonly "options"?: readonly AsamOption<V, I>[] | undefined;
	readonly "fetchSuggestions"?: AsamAutocompleteFetchSuggestions<T> | undefined;
	readonly "maxSuggestions"?: number | undefined;
	readonly "remoteSuggestions"?: ((query: string) => Promise<readonly AsamOption<V, I>[]>) | undefined;
	readonly "id"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "size"?: AsamControlSize | undefined;
	readonly "disabled"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "modelModifiers"?: (AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["modelModifiers"];
